title: Tenma Tsukasa — Taking The Stage〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Natalia Santi's “Living For The Stage”...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I bought it in order to get a better understanding of what we're doing for the workshop, but this is a bigger educational asset than I realized.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It includes everything from her process of getting into character to techniques of expression and bearing, and even vocal acting.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I see. This is what she was talking about the other day when we were discussing acting methods...)
Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This does such a good job of explaining all the things I couldn't quite wrap my head around.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll review this again before our next workshop meeting.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Can you hear me, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa, Rui?! How long have you been there?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That book must be very captivating.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mind if I ask what you're reading?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's a book by Natalia Santi, one of the workshop teachers.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I'm familiar with that one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's received quite a lot of praise for its eminently practical approach to acting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it should prove an invaluable tool while we attend this workshop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Particularly because the material is so advanced.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The teachers are world-class, of course, and the participating members of ArcLand are seasoned veterans as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In almost every conversation, it's driven home how painfully shallow my understanding of the craft is.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. So that's why you're studying up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It sounds like things are hardly any easier over on the directors' course, either.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's all you were thinking about during class today, right? Your attention was a thousand miles away.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your eyes are sharp.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're spot on, Tsukasa.
This assignment is proving quite a difficult one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's not easy to change up one's entire approach to showmaking.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
It sounds like we're both going to be wracking our heads for a while.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At the same time... It's thrilling, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've learned a lot through our training until now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And the more we learn, the more we see we need to work on.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In other words, we still have so much room to grow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I'm going to take this opportunity to grow once again, and get one step closer to becoming a star!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. A typically Tsukasa-like positive outlook.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But, you're right... This has been a fun challenge.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, look at the time...
We've been talking so long that lunch is almost half over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's hurry up and finish eating so that we're ready for classes this afternoon!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you should probably hurry.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Me? What about you? Aren't you having lunch?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'll just stick with this drink.
I'd rather spend as much time as I can working on my show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There you go again...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you don't eat properly, then you're going to struggle to come up with good ideas!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You really didn't bring anything?
If so, I'll share some of my food with you. Eat up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Alright...
I suppose I should listen to what my troupe leader has to say.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well said.
So, let's eat!
